```{r data_preprocessing, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: ATAC-seq data loading and preprocessing
# Workflow: Part 02 - sfATAC-seq downstream analysis

# ==================== ATAC-seq Data Loading and Preprocessing ====================
library(readr)
library(Matrix)
library(edgeR)

# ==================== Configuration ====================
COUNT_FILE <- "./results/merged_peaks/raw_atac_counts.tsv"  # Output from merge_peaks.sh
GROUP_FILE <- "./data/atac_group.csv"                        # Sample group information
OUTPUT_DIR <- "./results"                                     # Output directory

# ==================== Create Output Directories ====================
dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "figures"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ==================== Load Data ====================
message("[", Sys.time(), "] Loading count data from: ", COUNT_FILE)
df <- read_tsv(COUNT_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Check peak ID column
if (!("id" %in% colnames(df))) {
  if (ncol(df) >= 4) {
    colnames(df)[4] <- "id"
  } else stop("Input matrix has <4 columns; cannot find peak id.")
}

# Extract peak IDs and count matrix
peak_ids <- as.character(df$id)
count_matrix <- as.matrix(df[, 5:ncol(df), drop = FALSE])
rownames(count_matrix) <- peak_ids
mode(count_matrix) <- "integer"

# Get sample names
samples <- colnames(count_matrix)

# ==================== Load Group Information ====================
message("[", Sys.time(), "] Loading group information from: ", GROUP_FILE)
group <- read.csv(GROUP_FILE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Check if all samples are in group file
missing_group <- setdiff(samples, group$sample)
if (length(missing_group) > 0) {
  stop("Missing samples in group file: ", paste(missing_group, collapse = ", "))
}

# Ensure sample order matches
group <- group[match(samples, group$sample), ]

message("Loaded ", length(peak_ids), " peaks and ", length(samples), " samples")

# ==================== TMM Normalization (save cpm_tmm for PCA) ====================
message("[", Sys.time(), "] Performing TMM normalization...")
dge <- DGEList(counts = count_matrix)
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge, method = "TMMwsp")
cpm_tmm <- cpm(dge, log = FALSE)  # Save for PCA

# ==================== Save Processed Data ====================
message("[", Sys.time(), "] Saving results...")

# Save count matrix
write.csv(count_matrix, 
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "tables", "atac_counts.csv"))

# Save cpm_tmm (for PCA)
write.csv(cpm_tmm, 
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "tables", "atac_cpm_tmm.csv"))

# Save group information
write.csv(group, 
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "tables", "atac_group.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# ==================== Save as List Object ====================
atac_data <- list(
  counts_raw = count_matrix,
  group = group,
  samples = samples,
  peaks = peak_ids,
  dge = dge,
  cpm_tmm = cpm_tmm
)

message("------------------------------------------------")
message("[", Sys.time(), "] Preprocessing complete.")
message("Samples: ", length(samples))
message("Peaks: ", length(peak_ids))
message("Count matrix saved to: ", file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "tables", "atac_counts.csv"))
```

```{r peak_annotation, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: ATAC-seq peak annotation using ChIPseeker
# Workflow: Part 02 - sfATAC-seq downstream analysis

library(GenomicRanges)
library(GenomeInfoDb)
library(ChIPseeker)
library(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(dplyr)

# ==================== Configuration ====================
PEAK_FILE <- "./results/merged_peaks/raw_atac_counts.tsv"  # Peak file with genomic coordinates
OUTPUT_DIR <- "./results/tables"                            # Output directory

# Create output directory
dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ==================== Load Peak Information ====================
df <- read_tsv(PEAK_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE)

# ==================== Build GRanges Object ====================
peak_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = df$chr,
  ranges = IRanges(start = df$start, end = df$end),
  strand = "*"
)
names(peak_gr) <- df$id

# ==================== Standardize Chromosome Style and Filter ====================
seqlevelsStyle(peak_gr) <- "UCSC"
txdb <- TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene

# Keep only standard chromosomes
peak_gr <- keepSeqlevels(
  peak_gr, 
  intersect(seqlevels(peak_gr), seqlevels(txdb)),
  pruning.mode = "coarse"
)

# ==================== Peak Annotation ====================
peak_anno <- annotatePeak(
  peak_gr, 
  TxDb = txdb, 
  tssRegion = c(-1000, 1000),
  annoDb = "org.Hs.eg.db"
)

# Convert to data frame
annotated_df <- as.data.frame(peak_anno)
annotated_df$peak_id <- names(peak_gr)

# ==================== Save Annotation Results ====================
output_file <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "atac_peaks_annotated.csv")
write.csv(annotated_df, output_file, row.names = FALSE)

# ==================== Return Annotation Results ====================
atac_peak_annotation <- annotated_df
```

```{r peak_coefficient_of_variation, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: Coefficient of Variation (CV) analysis for ATAC-seq peaks
# Workflow: Part 02 - sfATAC-seq downstream analysis

library(matrixStats)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

# ==================== Configuration ====================
OUTPUT_DIR <- "./results"
topN <- 33287
threshold_mean <- 1
eps <- 1e-8
test_method <- "t.test"

# Create output directories
dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "figures"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ==================== Data Preparation ====================
cpm_tmm <- atac_data$cpm_tmm
group <- atac_data$group

# 1) Use top_peaks from PCA if available, otherwise select by variance
if (exists("pca_out") && !is.null(pca_out$top_peaks)) {
  top_peaks <- intersect(pca_out$top_peaks, rownames(cpm_tmm))
  if (length(top_peaks) == 0) stop("pca_out$top_peaks not found in cpm_tmm")
} else {
  rv <- rowVars(cpm_tmm)
  names(rv) <- rownames(cpm_tmm)
  topN_use <- min(topN, length(rv))
  top_peaks <- names(sort(rv, decreasing = TRUE))[1:topN_use]
}

# 2) Subset cpm and align groups
cpm_top <- cpm_tmm[top_peaks, , drop = FALSE]
group_in_mat <- group[group$sample %in% colnames(cpm_top), , drop = FALSE]

black_samples <- group_in_mat$sample[group_in_mat$colour == "Black"]
gray_samples  <- group_in_mat$sample[group_in_mat$colour == "Gray"]

# 3) Calculate mean, sd, CV%
mean_black <- rowMeans(cpm_top[, colnames(cpm_top) %in% black_samples, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
sd_black   <- rowSds(cpm_top[, colnames(cpm_top) %in% black_samples, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
cv_black   <- sd_black / (mean_black + eps) * 100

mean_gray <- rowMeans(cpm_top[, colnames(cpm_top) %in% gray_samples, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
sd_gray   <- rowSds(cpm_top[, colnames(cpm_top) %in% gray_samples, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
cv_gray   <- sd_gray / (mean_gray + eps) * 100

# 4) Filter: keep peaks with mean >= threshold in at least one group
keep_by_mean <- (mean_black >= threshold_mean) | (mean_gray >= threshold_mean)
sel_peaks <- top_peaks[keep_by_mean]

# 5) Prepare plot data
cv_df <- data.frame(peak = sel_peaks,
                    Black = cv_black[sel_peaks],
                    Gray  = cv_gray[sel_peaks],
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

df_long <- cv_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Black", "Gray"), names_to = "colour", values_to = "CV") %>%
  mutate(logCV = log10(CV + eps))

# 6) Save CV results
write.csv(cv_df, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "tables", "atac_cv_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# 7) Generate plot
y_max <- max(df_long$logCV, na.rm = TRUE)
y_pos <- y_max + 0.08 * max(1, abs(y_max))

cv_vln <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = colour, y = logCV, fill = colour, color = colour)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, width = 0.9) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.size = 0.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), coef = 1.5) +
  xlab("Group") + ylab("log10(Coefficient of variation)") +
  stat_compare_means(method = test_method, label = "p.signif", 
                     label.y = y_pos, label.x = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Black" = "#3f60aa", "Gray" = "#cc340c")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Black" = "#3f60aa", "Gray" = "#cc340c")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.position = "none")

# Save figure
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "figures", "atac_cv_violin.png"), 
       cv_vln, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
print(cv_vln)
```

```{r peak_count_statistics, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: Peak count statistics per sample for ATAC-seq
# Workflow: Part 02 - sfATAC-seq downstream analysis

library(matrixStats)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

# ==================== Configuration ====================
OUTPUT_DIR <- "./results"
presence_threshold <- 10
test_method <- "t.test"
use_pca_top_peaks_if_exists <- TRUE

# Create output directories
dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "figures"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ==================== Data Preparation ====================
mat <- atac_data$cpm_tmm
group <- atac_data$group

# 1) Use PCA top_peaks if available
if (use_pca_top_peaks_if_exists && exists("pca_out") && !is.null(pca_out$top_peaks)) {
  top_peaks <- intersect(pca_out$top_peaks, rownames(mat))
  if (length(top_peaks) > 0) {
    mat <- mat[top_peaks, , drop = FALSE]
  }
}

# 2) Align samples
samples_mat <- colnames(mat)
group_in_mat <- group[group$sample %in% samples_mat, , drop = FALSE]

# 3) Calculate present peak count per sample (CPM >= threshold)
pres_mat <- (mat >= presence_threshold)
counts_per_sample <- colSums(pres_mat, na.rm = TRUE)

# 4) Prepare plot data
df_counts <- data.frame(
  sample = names(counts_per_sample),
  peak_count = as.integer(counts_per_sample),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Match group information
group_sub <- group[match(df_counts$sample, group$sample), , drop = FALSE]
df_counts <- cbind(df_counts, group_sub[, !colnames(group_sub) %in% "sample", drop = FALSE])

# 5) Factor levels
df_counts$colour <- factor(df_counts$colour, levels = c("Black", "Gray"))

# 6) Log transformation
df_counts$plot_y <- log2(df_counts$peak_count + 1)

# 7) Save statistics
write.csv(df_counts, 
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "tables", "atac_peakcount_stats.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# 8) Generate plot
p_peakcount <- ggplot(df_counts, aes(x = colour, y = plot_y, fill = colour, color = colour)) +  
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7, trim = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6, width = 0.8) +  
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.4) +
  stat_compare_means(method = test_method, label.x = 1.25, 
                     label.y = max(df_counts$plot_y) * 1.05, 
                     size = 3, bracket.size = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Black" = "#3f60aa", "Gray" = "#cc340c"), guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Black" = "#3f60aa", "Gray" = "#cc340c"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "", y = "Number of present peaks (log2)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray95", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 10)),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
  )

# 9) Display and save
print(p_peakcount)
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "figures", "atac_peakcount_violin.png"), 
       plot = p_peakcount, width = 5, height = 4, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# 10) Return results
peakcount_res <- list(
  presence_threshold = presence_threshold,
  counts_df = df_counts,
  plot = p_peakcount
)
```

```{r frip_analysis, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: FRiP (Fraction of Reads in Peaks) analysis for ATAC-seq
# Workflow: Part 02 - sfATAC-seq downstream analysis

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

# ==================== Configuration ====================
OUTPUT_DIR <- "./results"
FRIP_FILE <- "./data/frip.tsv"                    # FRiP results file
GROUP_FILE <- "./data/atac_group.csv"              # Group information file
test_method <- "t.test"
cols_map <- c("Black" = "#3f60aa", "Gray" = "#cc340c")

# Create output directories
dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "figures"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ==================== Load Data ====================
fr_raw <- read_tsv(FRIP_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Process FRiP data (columns: sample, total_mapped, in_peaks, FRiP)
fr <- fr_raw %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, FRiP) %>%
  mutate(FRiP = as.numeric(FRiP))

# Load group information
group <- read.csv(GROUP_FILE)

# Merge with group information
fr2 <- left_join(fr, group, by = "sample") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(FRiP), !is.na(colour))

# ==================== Filter Samples ====================
# Use QC-passed samples from atac_data
keep_samples <- atac_data$samples
present_keep <- intersect(keep_samples, fr2$sample)
df <- fr2 %>% filter(sample %in% present_keep)

# Set factor levels
df$colour <- factor(df$colour, levels = c("Black", "Gray"))

# ==================== Calculate y-axis position ====================
y_pos <- max(df$FRiP, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15

# ==================== Generate Plot ====================
p_frip <- ggplot(df, aes(x = colour, y = FRiP, fill = colour, color = colour)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7, trim = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6, width = 0.8) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.4) +
  stat_compare_means(method = test_method, 
                     label.x = 1.25, 
                     label.y = y_pos,
                     size = 3,
                     bracket.size = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_map, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_map, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "", y = "FRiP") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray95", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black")
  )

# ==================== Display and Save ====================
print(p_frip)

# Save figure
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "figures", "atac_frip.png"), 
       p_frip, width = 5, height = 4, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# Save data
write.csv(df, 
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "tables", "atac_frip.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# ==================== Return Results ====================
frip_plot_res <- list(
  df = df,
  plot = p_frip
)
```

```{r pca_analysis, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: PCA analysis for ATAC-seq data
# Workflow: Part 02 - sfATAC-seq downstream analysis

library(Matrix)
library(matrixStats)
library(reshape2)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggplot2)

# ==================== Configuration ====================
OUTPUT_DIR <- "./results"
topN <- nrow(atac_data$cpm_tmm)  # Use all peaks

# Create output directories
dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "figures"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ==================== Data Preparation ====================
cpm_matrix <- atac_data$cpm_tmm  # Unlogged CPM matrix
group_df <- atac_data$group
samples <- colnames(cpm_matrix)

# ==================== Select Highly Variable Peaks ====================
rv <- rowVars(cpm_matrix)
names(rv) <- rownames(cpm_matrix)
topN_use <- min(topN, length(rv))
top_peaks <- names(sort(rv, decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(topN_use)]
mat_top <- cpm_matrix[top_peaks, , drop = FALSE]

# ==================== PCA Analysis ====================
counts_t <- t(mat_top)  # rows = samples, columns = peaks
pca_res <- prcomp(counts_t, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
pca.variance <- (pca_res$sdev^2) / sum(pca_res$sdev^2)
nPCs <- length(pca_res$sdev)

# ==================== Build PCA Data Frame ====================
pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x[, seq_len(nPCs), drop = FALSE])
pca_df$sample <- rownames(pca_df)
pca_df <- cbind(pca_df, group_df[match(pca_df$sample, group_df$sample), 
                                  setdiff(colnames(group_df), "sample"), drop = FALSE])

# ==================== PC Significance Tests ====================
pctest <- sapply(seq_len(nPCs), function(k){
  x <- try(t.test(pca_df[[paste0("PC", k)]] ~ pca_df$colour), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(x, "try-error")) NA_real_ else round(x$p.value, 4)
})
pctest <- setNames(as.data.frame(t(pctest)), paste0("PC", seq_len(nPCs)))

# ==================== PCA Scatter Plot (PC1 vs PC7) ====================
i <- 1; j <- 7
pca_df$PCx <- pca_df[[paste0("PC", i)]]
pca_df$PCy <- pca_df[[paste0("PC", j)]]

pcaplot <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PCx, y = PCy, color = colour)) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.4) +
  stat_ellipse(linetype = "longdash", linewidth = 0.6, level = 0.95, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Hair Colour", 
                     values = c("Black" = "#3f60aa", "Gray" = "#cc340c")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black"),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 13, face = "bold"),
        aspect.ratio = 1) +
  labs(x = paste0("PC", i, " (", signif(pca.variance[i] * 100, 3), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC", j, " (", signif(pca.variance[j] * 100, 3), "%)"),
       title = "")

# Save PCA plot
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "figures", "atac_pca_pc1_vs_pc7.png"), 
       pcaplot, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
print(pcaplot)

# ==================== PC1-10 Boxplot ====================
pc_long <- reshape2::melt(pca_df[, paste0("PC", 1:10)])
colnames(pc_long) <- c("variable", "value")
pc_long$colour <- rep(pca_df$colour, times = 10)

pcs_boxplot <- ggboxplot(pc_long, x = 'variable', y = 'value', color = 'colour',
                         ylab = "Coordinates", xlab = "",
                         width = 0.6, add = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#3f60aa", "#cc340c")) +
  stat_compare_means(aes(group = colour), method = "t.test",
                     symnum.args = list(cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1),
                                        symbols = c("***", "**", "*", " ")),
                     label = "p.signif")

# Save boxplot
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "figures", "atac_pcs_boxplot.png"), 
       plot = pcs_boxplot, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
print(pcs_boxplot)

# ==================== Save PCA Results ====================
pca_out <- list(
  pca_res = pca_res,
  pca_df = pca_df,
  pctest = pctest,
  top_peaks = top_peaks,
  mat_top = mat_top,
  counts_t = counts_t,
  pca.variance = pca.variance,
  nPCs = nPCs
)

# Save PC significance results
write.csv(pctest, 
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "tables", "atac_pc_significance.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r pc_variance_test, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: Violin plots with variance tests for ATAC-seq principal components
# Workflow: Part 02 - sfATAC-seq downstream analysis

library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)

# ---------------- Violin Plot Function ----------------
plot_pca_violin_with_var_test_atac <- function(pca_df, top_n_pcs = 10) {
  # Check pca_df
  if (!("sample" %in% colnames(pca_df))) stop("pca_df must contain sample column")
  if (!("colour" %in% colnames(pca_df))) stop("pca_df must contain colour column")
  pc_cols <- paste0("PC", 1:top_n_pcs)
  missing_pc <- setdiff(pc_cols, colnames(pca_df))
  if (length(missing_pc) > 0) stop("pca_df missing PC columns: ", paste(missing_pc, collapse = ", "))

  # Step 1: reshape PCA matrix (first top_n_pcs PCs)
  pca_long <- data.frame(sample = pca_df$sample, pca_df[, pc_cols, drop = FALSE], check.names = FALSE)
  pcdensity <- reshape2::melt(pca_long, id.vars = "sample", variable.name = "PC", value.name = "value")

  # Step 2: add group info
  pcdensity$colour <- pca_df$colour[match(pcdensity$sample, pca_df$sample)]
  pcdensity$colour <- factor(pcdensity$colour, levels = unique(pca_df$colour))

  # Step 3: statistics + direction
  stat_result <- pcdensity %>%
    group_by(PC) %>%
    summarise(
      t_p = tryCatch(t.test(value ~ colour)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_),
      var_p = tryCatch(var.test(value ~ colour)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_),
      mean_gray = if ("Gray" %in% unique(colour)) mean(value[colour == "Gray"], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      mean_black = if ("Black" %in% unique(colour)) mean(value[colour == "Black"], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      y = max(value, na.rm = TRUE) + (max(value, na.rm = TRUE) - min(value, na.rm = TRUE)) * 0.15
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      t_star = case_when(
        is.na(t_p) ~ "NA",
        t_p < 0.001 ~ "***",
        t_p < 0.01 ~ "**",
        t_p < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      ),
      var_star = case_when(
        is.na(var_p) ~ "NA",
        var_p < 0.001 ~ "***",
        var_p < 0.01 ~ "**",
        var_p < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      ),
      direction_label = case_when(
        abs(mean_gray - mean_black) < 1e-6 ~ "~",
        mean_gray > mean_black ~ "Gray ↑",
        mean_gray < mean_black ~ "Black ↑",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      label = paste0(var_star)
    )

  stat_result$PC <- factor(stat_result$PC, levels = paste0("PC", 1:top_n_pcs))

  # Step 4: generate plot
  violin_plot <- ggplot(pcdensity, aes(x = colour, y = value, fill = colour)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, scale = "width", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA) +
    facet_wrap(~PC, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) +
    geom_text(data = stat_result, aes(x = 1.5, y = y, label = label),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.8, lineheight = 1.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Gray" = "#cc340c", "Black" = "#3f60aa")) +
    labs(x = "", y = "PC Score", fill = "Group") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "top",
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12)
    )

  print(violin_plot)
  
  # Save figure
  ggsave(file.path("results/figures", "atac_pca_violin_var_test.png"), 
         plot = violin_plot, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

  return(stat_result)
}

# ---------------- Execute Function and Save Results ----------------
usePCsToReport <- 10
var_result_table_atac <- plot_pca_violin_with_var_test_atac(pca_df, top_n_pcs = usePCsToReport)

# Save statistical results
write.csv(var_result_table_atac, 
          file.path("results/tables", "atac_pca_var_test_results.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r permanova_analysis, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: PERMANOVA analysis on weighted principal components for ATAC-seq
# Workflow: Part 02 - sfATAC-seq downstream analysis

library(vegan)

# ==================== Configuration ====================
OUTPUT_DIR <- "./results"
set.seed(123)

# ==================== Data Preparation ====================
group_df <- atac_data$group
group_df$age <- as.numeric(as.character(group_df$age))

# ==================== Extract All PCs and Weight ====================
all_pcs <- pca_df[, grep("^PC\\d+$", colnames(pca_df)), drop = FALSE]
n_pcs <- ncol(all_pcs)
pca_vars <- pca.variance[1:n_pcs]
pca_weighted <- sweep(all_pcs, 2, sqrt(pca_vars), "*")

# ==================== PERMANOVA Analysis ====================
permanova_weighted <- adonis2(pca_weighted ~ colour + age + gender + donor,
                             data = group_df,
                             permutations = 999,
                             method = "euclidean",
                             by = "terms")

# ==================== Save Results ====================
write.csv(as.data.frame(permanova_weighted), 
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "tables", "atac_permanova_results.csv"),
          row.names = TRUE)

# ==================== Return Results ====================
atac_permanova <- permanova_weighted
```

```{r loading_peaks_extraction, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: Extract significant loading peaks for each PC using Z-score threshold
# Workflow: Part 02 - sfATAC-seq downstream analysis

# -------- Extract PCA Loadings (Based on Z-score Threshold) --------
rotation <- as.data.frame(pca_out$pca_res$rotation)

# -------- Parameter Settings --------
outdir <- "results/tables/loading_peaks"
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

target_p <- 0.05  # Two-tailed significance level
z_threshold <- qnorm(1 - target_p / 2)  # Z-score threshold

# -------- Load Annotation Table --------
annotated_df <- read.csv(
  file.path("results/tables", "atac_peaks_annotated.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Safety check
stopifnot("peak_id" %in% colnames(annotated_df))

# -------- Extract Significant Loading Peaks for Each PC --------
all_topload <- list()

for (i in 1:10) {
  pc_loading <- rotation[, i]  # Loading vector for current PC
  
  # Standardize to Z-score (preserve row names = peak_id)
  pc_z <- scale(pc_loading)[, 1]
  names(pc_z) <- rownames(rotation)

  # Find positive and negative significant peaks
  pos_idx <- which(pc_z > z_threshold)
  neg_idx <- which(pc_z < -z_threshold)

  # Positive significant
  positive <- if (length(pos_idx) > 0) {
    data.frame(
      peak_id = rownames(rotation)[pos_idx],
      zscore  = pc_z[pos_idx],
      loading = pc_loading[pos_idx],
      group   = "positive",
      pc      = i,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else data.frame()

  # Negative significant
  negative <- if (length(neg_idx) > 0) {
    data.frame(
      peak_id = rownames(rotation)[neg_idx],
      zscore  = pc_z[neg_idx],
      loading = pc_loading[neg_idx],
      group   = "negative",
      pc      = i,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else data.frame()

  # Combine
  topload <- rbind(positive, negative)

  # Merge with annotations
  if (nrow(topload) > 0) {
    annotated <- merge(topload, annotated_df, by = "peak_id", all.x = TRUE)

    # Save
    output_file <- file.path(outdir, paste0("PC", i, "_TOPpeak.csv"))
    write.csv(annotated, output_file, row.names = FALSE)
  }

  # Store in list
  all_topload[[i]] <- annotated
}

# -------- Combine All PC Results --------
final_table <- do.call(rbind, all_topload)
write.csv(final_table, file.path(outdir, "all_TOPpeak.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r loading_heatmap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: Heatmap visualization of significant loading peaks for selected PCs
# Workflow: Part 02 - sfATAC-seq downstream analysis

library(pheatmap)
library(dplyr)

# ====== Parameter Settings ======
output_dir <- "results/figures"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ====== Function to Plot Loading Heatmap for a Single PC ======
plot_pc_loading_heatmap <- function(target_pc) {
  
  # Extract loading peaks for this PC (both positive and negative)
  topload <- all_topload[[target_pc]]
  if (is.null(topload) || nrow(topload) < 2) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Preserve original order and direction
  ordered_peaks <- topload$peak_id
  peak_group_label <- topload$group  # "positive" / "negative"
  
  # Expression matrix processing (logCPM + selection + scaling)
  expr_mat <- atac_data$cpm_tmm[ordered_peaks, , drop = FALSE]
  expr_mat <- expr_mat[match(ordered_peaks, rownames(expr_mat)), ]  
  expr_mat_scaled <- t(scale(t(as.matrix(expr_mat))))  
  expr_mat_scaled[is.na(expr_mat_scaled)] <- 0  
  
  # Sample group information
  group_df <- atac_data$group
  
  # Get PC scores for sample ordering
  pc_scores <- pca_out$pca_res$x[, target_pc]
  names(pc_scores) <- rownames(pca_out$pca_res$x)
  
  # Order samples by group + PC score
  black_samples <- group_df$sample[group_df$colour == "Black"]
  gray_samples <- group_df$sample[group_df$colour == "Gray"]
  
  black_ordered <- black_samples[order(pc_scores[black_samples])]
  gray_ordered <- gray_samples[order(pc_scores[gray_samples])]
  
  # Combine: Black on left, Gray on right
  final_order <- c(black_ordered, gray_ordered)
  
  # Reorder matrix
  expr_final <- expr_mat_scaled[, final_order, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Column annotation
  col_anno <- data.frame(
    Colour = group_df$colour[match(final_order, group_df$sample)]
  )
  rownames(col_anno) <- final_order
  
  # Color settings
  annotation_colors <- list(
    Colour = c(Black = "#2166AC", Gray = "#B2182B")
  )
  color_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("#2166ac", "white", "#b2182b"))(100)
  breaks_range  <- seq(-2, 2, length.out = 91)
  
  # Generate heatmap
  pm <- pheatmap(expr_final,
                 cluster_rows = TRUE,
                 cluster_cols = FALSE,
                 show_rownames = FALSE,
                 show_colnames = FALSE,
                 annotation_row = NA,
                 annotation_col = col_anno,
                 annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
                 annotation_legend = FALSE,
                 legend = FALSE,
                 main = "",
                 color = color_palette,
                 breaks = breaks_range,
                 border_color = NA,
                 annotation_names_row = FALSE,
                 annotation_names_col = FALSE,
                 treeheight_row = 0)
  
  # Save
  outfile <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("atac_PC", target_pc, "_loading_heatmap.png"))
  png(outfile, width = 2500, height = 1500, res = 300)
  print(pm)
  dev.off()
  
  return(pm)
}

# ====== Generate Heatmaps for PC1 and PC7 ======
for (pc in c(1, 7)) {
  plot_pc_loading_heatmap(pc)
}
```

```{r peak_distribution, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: Stacked barplot showing genomic distribution of significant loading peaks
# Workflow: Part 02 - sfATAC-seq downstream analysis

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ====== Load Annotation Table ======
annotated_df <- read.csv(
  file.path("results/tables", "atac_peaks_annotated.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ====== Define Distribution Function ======
get_distribution <- function(peaks, group_name, annotated_df) {
  df <- subset(annotated_df, peak_id %in% peaks$peak_id)
  df$annotation <- replace(df$annotation, grepl("Intron", df$annotation), "Intron")
  df$annotation <- replace(df$annotation, grepl("Exon",   df$annotation), "Exon")
  df <- df[!is.na(df$annotation), ]
  dis <- as.data.frame(table(df$annotation), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  dis$group <- group_name
  names(dis) <- c("Distribution", "Freq", "group")
  return(dis)
}

# ====== Define Plot Function ======
plot_pc_distribution <- function(spc) {
  
  # Select loading peaks for this PC
  select_loading_peak <- all_topload[[spc]]
  if (is.null(select_loading_peak) || nrow(select_loading_peak) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Get distribution for negative and positive groups
  negadis <- get_distribution(
    peaks = subset(select_loading_peak, group == "negative"),
    group_name = "negative",
    annotated_df = annotated_df
  )
  posidis <- get_distribution(
    peaks = subset(select_loading_peak, group == "positive"),
    group_name = "positive",
    annotated_df = annotated_df
  )
  
  # Combine and calculate proportions
  pc_peakdis <- bind_rows(posidis, negadis) %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    mutate(Proportion = Freq / sum(Freq)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Define stack order
  stack_order <- c("3' UTR", "5' UTR", "Distal Intergenic",
                   "Downstream (<=300bp)", "Exon", "Intron", "Promoter")
  
  present_levels <- intersect(stack_order, unique(pc_peakdis$Distribution))
  pc_peakdis$Distribution <- factor(pc_peakdis$Distribution, levels = present_levels)
  
  pc_peakdis <- pc_peakdis %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    mutate(Proportion = Freq / sum(Freq)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # X-axis label mapping
  label_map <- c("negative" = "Black", "positive" = "Gray")
  
  # Generate plot
  peak_barplot <- ggplot(pc_peakdis, aes(x = group, y = Proportion, fill = Distribution)) +   
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.92, color = NA) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion", title = paste0("PC", spc)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.06)),
                       labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.08, 0.08)),
                     labels = label_map) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "3' UTR"               = "#8DD3C7",
      "5' UTR"               = "#FFFFB3",
      "Distal Intergenic"    = "#BEBADA",
      "Downstream (<=300bp)" = "#FB8072",
      "Exon"                 = "#80B1D3",
      "Intron"               = "#FDB462",
      "Promoter"             = "#B3DE69"
    )[present_levels],
    breaks = present_levels,
    na.value = "grey80") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0, vjust = 1.2),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 13),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, margin = margin(r = 14)),
      plot.margin = unit(c(10, 12, 8, 8), "pt")
    )
  
  print(peak_barplot)
  
  # Save figure
  outfile <- file.path("results/figures", paste0("atac_PC", spc, "_peak_distribution.png"))
  ggsave(outfile, peak_barplot, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
  
  return(peak_barplot)
}

# ====== Generate Distribution Plots for PC1 and PC7 ======
for (pc in c(1, 7)) {
  plot_pc_distribution(pc)
}
```

```{r rgreat_input_preparation, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: Export peaks for rGREAT analysis (BED + CSV format)
# Workflow: Part 02 - sfATAC-seq downstream analysis

# ========== Export Peaks for Specific PC & Group ==========

# Output directory
outdir <- "results/tables/rgreat_input"
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Target PCs and groups
target_pcs <- c(1, 7)
target_groups <- c("positive", "negative")

# Load required packages
library(GenomicRanges)
library(GenomeInfoDb)

# Helper: safely get peak_id column
ensure_peak_id <- function(df) {
  if (!is.data.frame(df)) df <- as.data.frame(df, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (!("peak_id" %in% colnames(df))) {
    if (!is.null(rownames(df))) {
      df$peak_id <- rownames(df)
    } else stop("Data frame has no peak_id column and no rownames.")
  }
  df
}

# Helper: merge with annotated_df and build GRanges
clean_and_build_gr <- function(sub_df, annotated_df) {
  sub_df <- ensure_peak_id(sub_df)
  ann <- as.data.frame(annotated_df, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  if (!("peak_id" %in% colnames(ann))) stop("annotated_df must contain peak_id column")
  if (!all(c("seqnames","start","end") %in% colnames(ann))) {
    stop("annotated_df must contain seqnames, start, end columns")
  }
  
  # Align with annotated_df
  idx <- match(as.character(sub_df$peak_id), as.character(ann$peak_id))
  ann_sub <- ann[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  merged <- cbind(sub_df, ann_sub[, c("seqnames","start","end"), drop = FALSE])

  # Handle possible list columns
  extract_first <- function(x) {
    if (is.list(x)) sapply(x, function(v) if (is.null(v) || length(v)==0) NA else v[[1]]) else x
  }
  merged$seqnames <- as.character(extract_first(merged$seqnames))
  merged$start <- as.numeric(extract_first(merged$start))
  merged$end <- as.numeric(extract_first(merged$end))

  # Add chr prefix if needed
  if (!any(grepl("^chr", na.omit(merged$seqnames)))) {
    merged$seqnames <- paste0("chr", merged$seqnames)
  }

  # Filter invalid coordinates
  merged <- merged[!is.na(merged$seqnames) & !is.na(merged$start) & !is.na(merged$end) & 
                   merged$start < merged$end, , drop = FALSE]
  
  if (nrow(merged) == 0) {
    return(list(df = merged, gr = GRanges()))
  }

  # Build GRanges
  gr <- GRanges(seqnames = merged$seqnames,
                ranges = IRanges(start = merged$start, end = merged$end))
  names(gr) <- as.character(merged$peak_id)

  # Keep only standard chromosomes
  std_chrs <- paste0("chr", c(1:22, "X", "Y", "M"))
  gr <- keepSeqlevels(gr, intersect(seqlevels(gr), std_chrs), pruning.mode = "coarse")
  gr <- sort(gr)

  # Keep only retained peaks
  merged_keep <- merged[merged$peak_id %in% names(gr), , drop = FALSE]

  return(list(df = merged_keep, gr = gr))
}

# Execute export loop
for (pc in target_pcs) {
  if (!(pc %in% seq_along(all_topload))) next
  
  topdf <- all_topload[[pc]]
  if (!is.data.frame(topdf)) topdf <- as.data.frame(topdf, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  for (grp in target_groups) {
    if (!("group" %in% colnames(topdf))) next
    
    sub_df <- topdf[topdf$group == grp, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(sub_df) == 0) next
    
    res <- clean_and_build_gr(sub_df, annotated_df)
    if (length(res$gr) == 0) next
    
    # Write BED file
    bed_df <- data.frame(
      chr = as.character(seqnames(res$gr)),
      start = start(res$gr),
      end = end(res$gr),
      name = names(res$gr)
    )
    
    bed_fn <- file.path(outdir, paste0("PC", pc, "_", grp, "_query.bed"))
    write.table(bed_df, bed_fn, quote = FALSE, sep = "\t", 
                row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
    
    # Write CSV file
    csv_fn <- file.path(outdir, paste0("PC", pc, "_", grp, "_peaks.csv"))
    write.csv(res$df, csv_fn, row.names = FALSE)
  }
}
```

```{r great_enrichment_analysis, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: Multi-database GREAT enrichment analysis for ATAC-seq peaks
# Workflow: Part 02 - sfATAC-seq downstream analysis

# ------------------ Multi-database GREAT Analysis ------------------
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rGREAT)
library(GenomeInfoDb)
library(dplyr)

# ========== User Settings ==========
outdir <- "results/tables/rgreat_input"
save_dir <- file.path(outdir, "GREAT_results_multidb")
dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

beds <- list.files(outdir, pattern = "PC(1|7)_(positive|negative)_query.bed$", full.names = TRUE)
if (length(beds) == 0) stop("No matching BED files found")

species <- "hg38"
std_chrs <- paste0("chr", c(1:22, "X", "Y", "M"))
pval_thresh <- 0.05

# ========== Main Loop ==========
for (bedf in beds) {
  sample_base <- sub("_query$", "", tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(bedf)))
  
  # Read BED
  bed <- read.table(bedf, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  qgr <- GRanges(seqnames = bed[[1]], ranges = IRanges(start = bed[[2]], end = bed[[3]]))
  qgr <- keepSeqlevels(qgr, intersect(seqlevels(qgr), std_chrs), pruning.mode = "coarse")
  qgr <- sort(qgr)
  
  if (length(qgr) == 0) next

  # Submit GREAT job
  job <- submitGreatJob(
    qgr, 
    species = species,
    includeCuratedRegDoms = TRUE,
    rule = "basalPlusExt",
    adv_upstream = 5.0,
    adv_downstream = 1.0,
    adv_span = 1000.0
  )

  # Get all database results
  tb <- getEnrichmentTables(job, download_by = "tsv")
  if (is.null(tb)) next

  # Process each database
  for (db_name in names(tb)) {
    df <- as.data.frame(tb[[db_name]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    if (nrow(df) == 0) next
    
    df$Database <- db_name
    
    # Select p-value column
    pcol_candidates <- c("HyperBonfP", "HyperFdrQ", "BinomBonfP", "BinomFdrQ", "HyperP", "BinomP")
    pcol_use <- intersect(pcol_candidates, colnames(df))[1]
    
    if (!is.na(pcol_use)) {
      df_filtered <- df %>%
        filter(!is.na(!!sym(pcol_use)), !!sym(pcol_use) <= pval_thresh)
      
      if (nrow(df_filtered) > 0) {
        db_safe <- gsub("[ /:]", "_", db_name)
        outfile <- file.path(save_dir, paste0(sample_base, "_", db_safe, "_filtered.csv"))
        write.csv(df_filtered, outfile, row.names = FALSE)
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Combine all databases
  all_dfs <- list()
  for (db_name in names(tb)) {
    df <- as.data.frame(tb[[db_name]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    if (nrow(df) > 0) {
      df$Database <- db_name
      all_dfs[[db_name]] <- df
    }
  }
  
  if (length(all_dfs) > 0) {
    combined_df <- bind_rows(all_dfs)
    combined_file <- file.path(save_dir, paste0(sample_base, "_ALL_DATABASES.csv"))
    write.csv(combined_df, combined_file, row.names = FALSE)
  }
  
  Sys.sleep(2)
}
```

```{r rgreat_visualization, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: Visualization of rGREAT enrichment results
# Workflow: Part 02 - sfATAC-seq downstream analysis

# ========== rGREAT Results Visualization ==========
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# ========== Parameter Settings ==========
outdir <- "results/figures"
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# GREAT results path
great_dir <- "results/tables/rgreat_input/GREAT_results_multidb"

# Define four BP files to process
bp_files <- c(
  "PC1_negative_GO_Biological_Process_filtered.csv",
  "PC1_positive_GO_Biological_Process_filtered.csv", 
  "PC7_negative_GO_Biological_Process_filtered.csv",
  "PC7_positive_GO_Biological_Process_filtered.csv"
)

file_paths <- file.path(great_dir, bp_files)

# ========== Process Single File ==========
process_bp_file <- function(file_path, sample_name) {
  if (!file.exists(file_path)) return(NULL)
  
  df <- read.csv(file_path)
  
  df_clean <- df %>%
    select(Desc, BinomP, ObsGenes, TotalGenes) %>%
    mutate(
      neg_log_p = -log10(BinomP),
      GeneRatio = ObsGenes / TotalGenes,
      Desc_short = str_trunc(Desc, width = 40, side = "right"),
      Sample = sample_name
    ) %>%
    arrange(BinomP) %>%
    head(20) %>%
    mutate(Desc_short = factor(Desc_short, levels = rev(Desc_short)))
  
  return(df_clean)
}

# ========== Process All Files ==========
sample_names <- c("PC1 Negative", "PC1 Positive", "PC7 Negative", "PC7 Positive")

bp_list <- list()
for (i in seq_along(file_paths)) {
  res <- process_bp_file(file_paths[i], sample_names[i])
  if (!is.null(res)) bp_list[[i]] <- res
}

bp_all <- bind_rows(bp_list)

if (nrow(bp_all) == 0) stop("No enrichment results available")

# ========== Generate Plot ==========
colors <- c(
  "PC1 Negative" = "#1f77b4",
  "PC1 Positive" = "#ff7f0e",
  "PC7 Negative" = "#2ca02c",
  "PC7 Positive" = "#d62728"
)

p <- ggplot(bp_all, aes(x = neg_log_p, y = Desc_short, fill = Sample)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~Sample, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "-log10(p-value)", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

print(p)

# Save
ggsave(file.path(outdir, "atac_GO_BP_enrichment.png"), 
       p, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

```{r motif_visualization, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: Visualization of HOMER motif enrichment results
# Workflow: Part 02 - sfATAC-seq downstream analysis

# ========== HOMER Motif Results Visualization ==========
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)

# ========== Parameter Settings ==========
outdir <- "results/figures"
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Define four folders and corresponding sample names
motif_dirs <- c(
  "PC1_negative_homer",
  "PC1_positive_homer", 
  "PC7_negative_homer",
  "PC7_positive_homer"
)

sample_names <- c("PC1 Negative", "PC1 Positive", "PC7 Negative", "PC7 Positive")

base_path <- "results/motif_analysis"

# ========== Read and Process Each Motif File ==========
process_motif_file <- function(dir_path, sample_name) {
  file_path <- file.path(dir_path, "knownResults.txt")
  
  if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  df <- read.delim(file_path, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  df_clean <- df %>%
    mutate(
      temp_name = str_extract(.[[1]], "^[^/]+"),
      Motif_short = str_remove_all(temp_name, "\\([^)]*\\)"),
      Motif_short = str_trim(Motif_short),
      Motif_short = str_trunc(Motif_short, width = 20, side = "right"),
      P_val = as.numeric(.[[3]]),
      neg_log_p = -log10(P_val),
      Sample = sample_name
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(P_val)) %>%
    arrange(P_val) %>%
    head(20) %>%
    mutate(Motif_short = factor(Motif_short, levels = rev(unique(Motif_short))))
  
  return(df_clean)
}

# Process four folders
motif_list <- list()
for (i in seq_along(motif_dirs)) {
  dir_path <- file.path(base_path, motif_dirs[i])
  motif_list[[i]] <- process_motif_file(dir_path, sample_names[i])
}

# Filter out NULL or empty data frames
motif_list <- motif_list[!sapply(motif_list, function(x) is.null(x) || nrow(x) == 0)]

if (length(motif_list) > 0) {
  motif_all <- bind_rows(motif_list)
  
  # Define colors
  colors <- c(
    "PC1 Negative" = "#1f77b4",
    "PC1 Positive" = "#ff7f0e", 
    "PC7 Negative" = "#2ca02c",
    "PC7 Positive" = "#d62728"
  )
  
  # Generate bar plot
  p <- ggplot(motif_all, aes(x = neg_log_p, y = Motif_short, fill = Sample)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~Sample, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors, guide = "none") +
    labs(x = "-log10(p-value)", y = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )
  
  print(p)
  
  # Save
  ggsave(file.path(outdir, "atac_motif_enrichment.png"), 
         p, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
}
```

```{r promoter_matrix, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Description: Aggregate ATAC-seq promoter peaks into gene-level matrix
# Workflow: Part 02 - sfATAC-seq downstream analysis

# ========== Aggregate ATAC-seq Promoter Peaks to Gene Matrix ==========
library(dplyr)
library(edgeR)

# ========== Function Definition ==========
make_promoter_matrix <- function(
  annotated_path = "results/tables/atac_peaks_annotated.csv",
  out_dir = "results/tables/integration",
  out_promoter_csv = file.path(out_dir, "atac_promoter_genes.csv"),
  out_group_csv = file.path(out_dir, "atac_group.csv"),
  agg_method = c("mean", "median", "sum", "weighted"),
  weighted_by = c("width", "none"),
  filter_min_rowMeanCPM = 0,
  do_log = FALSE,
  save_raw_gene_counts = TRUE
) {
  agg_method <- match.arg(agg_method)
  weighted_by <- match.arg(weighted_by)
  
  # Load annotations
  if (!file.exists(annotated_path)) stop("annotated_path not found: ", annotated_path)
  annotated_df <- read.csv(annotated_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (!("peak_id" %in% colnames(annotated_df) && "SYMBOL" %in% colnames(annotated_df))) {
    stop("annotated_df must contain peak_id and SYMBOL columns")
  }
  
  # Extract promoter regions
  peak2gene <- annotated_df %>%
    filter(grepl("Promoter", annotation, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
    dplyr::select(peak_id, SYMBOL) %>%
    filter(!is.na(SYMBOL), SYMBOL != "")
  
  if (nrow(peak2gene) == 0) stop("No promoter peaks found")
  
  # Get counts matrix
  if (!exists("atac_data")) stop("atac_data not found")
  counts_all <- atac_data$counts_raw
  
  # Keep only promoter peaks
  present_peaks <- intersect(peak2gene$peak_id, rownames(counts_all))
  if (length(present_peaks) == 0) stop("No promoter peaks in counts matrix")
  
  peak2gene <- peak2gene %>% filter(peak_id %in% present_peaks)
  promoter_counts <- counts_all[peak2gene$peak_id, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # Peak-level CPM normalization
  dge_peak <- DGEList(counts = promoter_counts)
  dge_peak <- calcNormFactors(dge_peak, method = "TMMwsp")
  peak_cpm <- cpm(dge_peak, log = FALSE)
  
  # Calculate peak widths (for weighted average)
  peak_widths <- NULL
  if (weighted_by == "width") {
    if ("width" %in% colnames(annotated_df)) {
      widths <- setNames(annotated_df$width, annotated_df$peak_id)
      peak_widths <- widths[peak2gene$peak_id]
    } else if (all(c("start", "end") %in% colnames(annotated_df))) {
      widths <- annotated_df$end - annotated_df$start + 1
      names(widths) <- annotated_df$peak_id
      peak_widths <- widths[peak2gene$peak_id]
    }
  }
  
  # Group by gene
  gene_groups <- peak2gene$SYMBOL[match(rownames(peak_cpm), peak2gene$peak_id)]
  unique_genes <- unique(gene_groups)
  
  # Aggregation function
  agg_fun <- switch(agg_method,
    mean = function(rows) colMeans(rows),
    median = function(rows) apply(rows, 2, median),
    sum = function(rows) colSums(rows),
    weighted = function(rows) {
      if (weighted_by == "width" && !is.null(peak_widths)) {
        w <- peak_widths[rownames(rows)]
        w[is.na(w)] <- 1
        w <- w / sum(w)
        colSums(rows * w)
      } else {
        colMeans(rows)
      }
    }
  )
  
  # Build gene matrix
  gene_mat <- t(vapply(unique_genes, function(g) {
    pids <- rownames(peak_cpm)[gene_groups == g]
    rows <- peak_cpm[pids, , drop = FALSE]
    as.numeric(agg_fun(rows))
  }, numeric(ncol(peak_cpm))))
  
  rownames(gene_mat) <- unique_genes
  colnames(gene_mat) <- colnames(peak_cpm)
  
  # Gene metadata
  n_peaks <- vapply(unique_genes, function(g) sum(gene_groups == g), integer(1))
  gene_meta <- data.frame(
    gene = unique_genes,
    n_peaks = n_peaks,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Filter low-expression genes
  if (filter_min_rowMeanCPM > 0) {
    row_means <- rowMeans(gene_mat)
    keep <- row_means >= filter_min_rowMeanCPM
    gene_mat <- gene_mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    gene_meta <- gene_meta[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  
  # Optional log transformation
  final_mat <- gene_mat
  if (do_log) final_mat <- log2(final_mat + 1)
  
  # Group information
  group_out <- atac_data$group
  
  # Save files
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  write.csv(group_out, out_group_csv, row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(as.data.frame(final_mat), out_promoter_csv, row.names = TRUE)
  
  if (save_raw_gene_counts) {
    gene_raw <- rowsum(promoter_counts, group = gene_groups)
    raw_file <- file.path(out_dir, "atac_promoter_raw_counts.csv")
    write.csv(as.data.frame(gene_raw), raw_file, row.names = TRUE)
  }
  
  return(list(
    gene_mat = as.data.frame(final_mat),
    gene_meta = gene_meta,
    group = group_out
  ))
}

# ========== Execute ==========
res <- make_promoter_matrix(
  agg_method = "weighted",
  weighted_by = "width",
  filter_min_rowMeanCPM = 0,
  do_log = TRUE,
  save_raw_gene_counts = TRUE
)
```
